experiment: Rich live scene context and pure-stdlib STBL string-table resolution across base game, packs, and mods

stbl_resolver.implementation: Pure Python 3.15 stdlib DBPF v2.0 + RefPack (0x10FB/0x50FB) + ZLIB + STBL v5 parser in companion.py
token_formatting: HTML tag stripping (<font ...>) and '(should not be seen)' debug string filtering

sim: visible buffs + name_stbl + reason_stbl -> active_buffs (e.g. {'name': 'Emotionally Mindful', 'reason': '(From Being Emotionally Mindful)'}, {'name': 'Feeling Great', 'reason': '(From High Needs)'})
scene_and_relationship: interaction + interaction_stbl -> interaction_label (e.g. 'Respectful Introduction', 'Discuss Local Fishing Spots', 'Discuss Logic Puzzles')
relationship bits + bit_stbls -> bit_labels (e.g. ['Neighbor', 'Good Compatibility', 'Casual Discussion', 'Acquaintances', 'Pleasant Conversation'])
bounded per-zone recent_dialogue buffer (last 3 exchanges) preventing repeated introductions

limits: Some internal tracker buffs or interactions do not define a user-facing STBL string ID and fall back to their tuning class name.
Complex nested localization tokens (such as dynamic object counts or career level numbers) are stripped rather than evaluated outside the game.
